sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} flatback turtle was tagged at {release_site} and tracked for {days_tracked}: {species_rank_days}.
Flatback turtles nest only in Australia and, unlike most sea turtles, stay on the continental shelf rather than crossing oceans.
On {farthest_date} she was {max_displacement_km} from where tracking began, {species_rank_distance}.
Her deepest recorded dive was {deepest_dive_m}, and her longest lasted {longest_dive_min}.
